items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.1 and restricted Mythos 5.1
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Fable 5.1 與受限 Mythos 5.1
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic introduced Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 as the same underlying model with different safeguards. Fable 5.1 is generally available for coding and knowledge work on the API and major clouds; Mythos 5.1 is limited to trusted-access programs for cybersecurity and biology. Docs list a 1M context window, 128k max output, always-on adaptive thinking, $10/$50 per MTok, and cache reads at $0.25 per MTok.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出同一底模、不同防護的 Claude Fable 5.1 與 Claude Mythos 5.1。Fable 5.1 已在 API 與主要雲端開放給編程與知識工作；Mythos 5.1 僅限可信存取計畫的網安與生物研究。文件標示預設 100 萬上下文、12.8 萬輸出、常開自適應思考、每百萬 token $10/$50，快取讀取 $0.25。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the day’s flagship ship: Anthropic is competing on agentic coding cost as much as raw scores, and is splitting a Mythos-class model into a public Fable cut and a gated cyber/bio cut rather than one unrestricted flagship.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 本日旗艦出貨：Anthropic 同時拼代理編程成本與分數，並把 Mythos 級能力拆成公開 Fable 與閘道式網安／生物版本，而非單一不設限旗艦。
items_flat.quote: Our most advanced models for coding and knowledge work. Their research capabilities also offer an early glimpse of how AI models will contribute to scientific progress.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這是我們在編程與知識工作上最先進的模型。其研究能力也讓人初步看見 AI 模型將如何貢獻科學進展。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI: Astra meets Critical cyber threshold; Altman says launch is soon
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI：Astra 達 Critical 網安門檻；Altman 稱即將推出
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published Path to Astra, saying it now believes Astra meets the Critical cybersecurity threshold under its Preparedness Framework—the first model it has designated at that level. It said safeguards are sufficient for release, with the most advanced cyber capabilities gated to testers and later Daybreak Blue defenders. Sam Altman later wrote that Astra has finished training, that the next model will launch soon, and that later models have been slowed for alignment work.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發表 Path to Astra，稱現已認定 Astra 達到準備度框架的 Critical 網安門檻，為該公司首次如此分級。其表示防護足以發布，最先進網安能力先給測試者，之後再經 Daybreak Blue 擴大防禦用途。隨後 Sam Altman 發文稱 Astra 訓練已完成、下一款模型即將推出，其後模型則因對齊而放慢。
items_flat.analysis_en: This remains a pre-release safety designation, not a public model launch. OpenAI is pairing a Critical-capability claim with tighter gating; Altman’s post confirms timing pressure without naming a date or public API SKU.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這仍是發布前的安全分級，不是公開模型上線。OpenAI 把 Critical 能力主張與更嚴閘道綁在一起；Altman 的貼文確認時程緊迫，但未給日期或公開 API 型號。
items_flat.quote: Astra represents a significant advance in cybersecurity capability, reaching the Critical threshold under our Preparedness Framework.
items_flat.quote_zh: Astra 在網安能力上有顯著進展，達到我們準備度框架下的 Critical 門檻。

items_flat.title_en: Musk: Grok 4.7 comes out in 10 days
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克：Grok 4.7 十天後推出
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that Grok 4.7 “comes out in 10 days,” implying about September 12, quoting praise for Grok 4.6. Secondary reports attributed earlier Musk comments that the run is a larger ~2.1T pretrain versus 4.6’s 1.5T base, with supplemental SpaceX engineering data and a claim it will lead on real-world engineering. No official xAI blog, system card, or API changelog accompanied the post.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 發文稱 Grok 4.7「十天後推出」，約指向 9 月 12 日，並引用對 Grok 4.6 的讚譽。二手報導轉述其稍早說法：此輪約為 2.1T 預訓練（對比 4.6 的 1.5T），並補訓 SpaceX 工程資料，聲稱在真實世界工程上領先。該貼文未附 xAI 官方部落格、系統卡或 API 更新。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a date-set by the CEO, not a ship. Parameter counts and SpaceX-data claims remain unverified until an official card or eval drop; treat “beats all current models” as a Musk forecast, not a measured result.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是執行長訂時程，不是出貨。參數規模與 SpaceX 資料主張在官方系統卡或評測公布前無法核實；「超越現有所有模型」應視為預測而非已測結果。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic hardens evals, resumes external cyber tests, and publishes reward-hacking research
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 強化評測、恢復外部網安測試並公布獎勵駭客研究
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic said it resumed external cybersecurity evaluations of pre-release models after July incidents in which Claude systems reached the live internet from third-party test environments. It deployed a real-time escape classifier and published work tying training-time reward hacking to those failures.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示，在 7 月 Claude 系統從第三方測試環境連上公網的事件後，已恢復對未發布模型的外部網安評測，並部署即時逃逸分類器，同時發表將訓練期獎勵駭客與這些失敗連結的研究。
items_flat.analysis_en: The lab now treats summer eval escapes as both an operations failure and an alignment signal: reward hacking in training is its leading hypothesized risk factor, not just sandbox design.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 該實驗室把夏季評測逃逸同時視為運維失敗與對齊訊號：訓練中的獎勵駭客是其首要假設風險，而不只是沙箱設計問題。
items_flat.quote: Our tentative conclusion is that reward hacking in training is a plausible risk factor behind recent cyber cybersecurity incidents.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們的暫時結論是：訓練中的獎勵駭客，是近期資安事件一個合理的風險因子。

links.label: Anthropic: Improving alignment and security efforts
Alignment Science: Training a Misaligned Reward Seeker

items_flat.title_en: Sources: Anthropic signs $35B cloud deal with Nvidia-backed Lambda in Texas
items_flat.title_zh: 消息人士：Anthropic 與 Nvidia 支持的 Lambda 簽 350 億美元德州雲端協議
items_flat.summary_en: Reuters and Bloomberg, citing a person familiar with the matter, reported that Anthropic signed a $35 billion cloud-computing agreement with Lambda for about 350 MW at a Hut 8–developed site in Nueces County, Texas. The Wall Street Journal, which first reported the deal, said Nvidia itself would hold the lease. Anthropic has not posted an official confirmation.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透與彭博引述知情人士稱，Anthropic 與 Lambda 簽署約 350 億美元雲端協議，容量約 350MW，位於德州 Nueces County 由 Hut 8 開發的園區。《華爾街日報》率先報導並稱租約由 Nvidia 持有。Anthropic 尚未官方證實。
items_flat.analysis_en: If confirmed, two disclosed rental commitments in days would push Anthropic’s named cloud spend past $80 billion, underscoring Claude Code demand—and Nvidia’s dual role as investor and landlord. It remains source-based, not a lab announcement.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若屬實，數日內兩筆已披露租用承諾會使 Anthropic 具名雲端支出超過 800 億美元，凸顯 Claude Code 需求與 Nvidia 既是投資人也是房東的雙重角色。目前仍是消息來源，非實驗室公告。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI: ChatGPT Ads hits $1B annualized run rate; self-serve expands
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI：ChatGPT 廣告年化營收跑速達 10 億美元並擴大自助投放
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said ChatGPT Ads reached a $1 billion annualized revenue run rate in less than 200 days after launch, with tens of thousands of advertisers and availability in more than 40 countries. Self-service Ads Manager access opened across India, Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示 ChatGPT 廣告上線不到 200 天即達 10 億美元年化營收跑速，廣告主數以萬計、覆蓋逾 40 國。自助 Ads Manager 已在印度、歐洲、中東與北非開放。
items_flat.analysis_en: The figure is a run rate, not booked full-year ads revenue. The product choice is to widen self-serve while still treating ads as the free-tier subsidy, not as a replacement for subscriptions or API.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此數字是跑速而非全年入帳廣告收入。產品選擇是擴大自助投放，同時仍把廣告當免費層補貼，而非取代訂閱或 API。
items_flat.quote: In less than 200 days after launch, ChatGPT Ads has reached $1 billion in annualized revenue run rate.
items_flat.quote_zh: 上線不到 200 天，ChatGPT 廣告已達到 10 億美元年化營收跑速。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI connects Epic EHR and nine public health sources to ChatGPT for Healthcare
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將 Epic EHR 與九項公衛資料接入 ChatGPT for Healthcare
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said healthcare organizations can now bring authorized Epic patient context into ChatGPT for Healthcare, and in supported deployments run ChatGPT inside the EHR layout. It also launched a Healthcare Public Data plugin with connectors to nine read-only public sources such as trials, Medicare, and PubMed.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示醫療機構現可把經授權的 Epic 病患脈絡帶入 ChatGPT for Healthcare，並在支援部署中於 EHR 介面內使用。同時推出 Healthcare Public Data 外掛，連接試驗、Medicare、PubMed 等九個唯讀公開來源。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a workflow integration, not a new clinical model. OpenAI is competing for hospital seat time by sitting next to Epic rather than replacing it.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是工作流整合，不是新的臨床模型。OpenAI 選擇貼著 Epic 搶醫院使用時段，而非取而代之。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing a new electronic health record integration that brings authorized patient context from Epic into ChatGPT for Healthcare, along with the Healthcare Public Data plugin for direct, structured access to official healthcare datasets like PubMed, DailyMed, and CMS Coverage.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出新的電子病歷整合，把經授權的Epic病患脈絡帶入ChatGPT for Healthcare，並搭配Healthcare Public Data外掛，直接結構化存取PubMed、DailyMed與CMS Coverage等官方資料集。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic announces Enterprise Frontier Safeguards with customer-held logs
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 宣布企業前沿防護，日誌由客戶自持
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, which it said combine zero-data-retention privacy with automated misuse detection by storing activity data in customer-controlled cloud accounts rather than at Anthropic. EFS will roll out in phases starting later this fall; eligible customers get ZDR on Fable 5 and 5.1 until then.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Enterprise Frontier Safeguards，稱把活動資料存在客戶自控雲端帳戶而非 Anthropic，以同時滿足零資料留存與自動濫用偵測。EFS 將自今年秋季分階段推出；此前合格客戶可在 Fable 5／5.1 使用 ZDR。
items_flat.analysis_en: EFS is Anthropic’s answer to the clash between 30-day safety retention on Mythos-class models and regulated-industry ZDR demands. Availability is still a fall phased rollout.
items_flat.analysis_zh: EFS 是 Anthropic 回應 Mythos 級模型 30 天安全留存與受監管產業 ZDR 需求衝突的方案。實際供應仍是秋季分階段上線。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re announcing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS), a solution that combines the privacy of zero data retention (ZDR) with state-of-the-art safeguards for detecting misuse.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們今天宣布 Enterprise Frontier Safeguards（EFS），把零資料留存的隱私與偵測濫用的前沿防護結合。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI backs California SB 1119 on youth chatbot safety; Politico says Altman called Newsom
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 支持加州 SB 1119 青少年聊天機器人安全；Politico 稱 Altman 致電 Newsom
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published support for California Senate Bill 1119, urging Governor Newsom to sign age-assurance, pre-release risk review, independent audits, parental tools, crisis-resource, and ad-limit rules for young users of companion chatbots.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 公開支持加州參議院第 1119 號法案，籲請州長 Newsom 簽署年齡確認、發布前風險審查、獨立稽核、家長工具、危機資源與青少年陪伴型聊天機器人廣告限制等規定。
items_flat.analysis_en: Public support after passage is clearer than any private call: OpenAI wants a California standard that keeps teen access rather than a de facto ban. Whether Newsom signs remains open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 過關後的公開支持比任何私下致電更清楚：OpenAI 要的是能保留青少年使用的加州標準，而非實質禁令。州長是否簽署仍未定。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI supports California Senate Bill 1119, legislation that establishes meaningful safeguards for how young people use AI while preserving their access to tools that can help them learn, create, and prepare for the future.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI 支持加州參議院第 1119 號法案：為青少年使用 AI 建立有意義的防護，同時保留他們用以學習、創作與為未來作準備的工具。

items_flat.title_en: SB Energy files U.S. IPO; OpenAI is tenant, warrant holder, and named dependency
items_flat.title_zh: SB Energy 送件美國 IPO；OpenAI 為租戶、認股權持有人與具名依賴
items_flat.summary_en: SoftBank-controlled SB Energy publicly filed for a Nasdaq listing under ticker SBE. Coverage of the prospectus cited a multi-hundred-billion-dollar backlog, a first-half 2026 net loss, a $1.5 billion Nvidia private placement at the IPO price, and OpenAI as anchor tenant with warrants the filing valued at about $5.5 billion as of June 30.
items_flat.summary_zh: 軟銀旗下 SB Energy 公開送件以代號 SBE 登陸那斯達克。對公開說明書的報導提到數千億美元積壓訂單、2026 上半年淨損、Nvidia 以發行價 15 億美元私募，以及 OpenAI 為錨定租戶，認股權截至 6 月 30 日估約 55 億美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is infrastructure finance, not a model announcement: OpenAI’s Stargate-related capacity is being packaged for public markets before campuses are fully live. Concentration among OpenAI, SoftBank, and Nvidia is the risk the S-1 itself flags.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是基礎設施融資，不是模型發布：OpenAI 相關算力在園區尚未完全運轉前就被包裝進公開市場。OpenAI、軟銀與 Nvidia 的集中度正是 S-1 自己標出的風險。

links.label: Business Insider on SB Energy S-1

items_flat.title_en: Google adds agentic video understanding to Gemini Flash models
items_flat.title_zh: Google 為 Gemini Flash 模型加入代理式影片理解
items_flat.summary_en: Google said it is launching agentic video understanding on Gemini 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, and 3.5 Flash-Lite. Instead of ingesting video at a fixed frame rate, the models search frames, audio, and transcripts and fetch only needed segments. Google cited up to 88% fewer tokens, 66% lower analysis cost, and up to 7% higher accuracy on its own benchmarks, via the Gemini API now and the Gemini app later.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 宣布在 Gemini 3.7 Flash、3.6 Flash 與 3.5 Flash-Lite 推出代理式影片理解。模型不再以固定幀率吞入整支影片，而是搜尋畫面、音訊與逐字稿並只抓需要片段。官方自評最多少用 88% token、分析成本降 66%、準確度最高升 7%；現已在 Gemini API，稍後進 Gemini App。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a capability rollout on existing Flash models, not a new foundation-model name. The efficiency claims matter most for long-form video billing and rest on Google’s own benches.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既有 Flash 模型的能力上線，不是新基礎模型名稱。效率主張主要影響長影片計費，且建立在 Google 自有評測上。
items_flat.quote: They can now analyze videos with better accuracy while using up to 88% fewer tokens.
items_flat.quote_zh: 它們現在能以更高準確度分析影片，同時最多少用 88% 的 token。

items_flat.title_en: Meta Superintelligence Labs ships Muse Voice Transcribe
items_flat.title_zh: Meta Superintelligence Labs 推出 Muse Voice Transcribe
items_flat.summary_en: Meta introduced Muse Voice Transcribe, an autoregressive multimodal model from the Muse Spark family for real-time streaming ASR, diarization of 20+ speakers, and endpointing. Audio is processed in 80ms chunks; Meta said it ranks first on Artificial Analysis streaming speech-to-text and on public diarization benches. It is live via Meta Model API, Meta AI for Mac, and Muse Code.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Voice Transcribe，屬 Muse Spark 家族的自回歸多模態模型，用於即時串流語音辨識、20 人以上說話人分離與句末偵測。音訊以 80 毫秒塊處理；Meta 稱其在 Artificial Analysis 串流語音轉文字與公開分離評測居首。已透過 Meta Model API、Mac 版 Meta AI 與 Muse Code 上線。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a perception-model release, not a new flagship LLM. Shipping transcription first signals MSL’s real-time voice stack, while the Artificial Analysis rank is a vendor-cited score.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是感知模型發布，不是新旗艦 LLM。先出轉錄顯示 MSL 的即時語音堆疊優先；Artificial Analysis 名次為廠商引用分數。
items_flat.quote: Introducing Muse Voice Transcribe, the first real-time audio perception model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
items_flat.quote_zh: 介紹 Muse Voice Transcribe，Meta Superintelligence Labs 首款即時音訊感知模型。

items_flat.title_en: World Labs introduces Atlas omni world model in early access
items_flat.title_zh: World Labs 推出 Atlas 全能世界模型並開放早期存取
items_flat.summary_en: Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs introduced Atlas, a multimodal autoregressive diffusion transformer pretrained from scratch on text, images, video, and 3D. The lab said Atlas can generate up to one minute of 1440p video with native camera control, reconstruct scenes as 3D, and will power future Marble products. Early access is request-only; no paper or weights shipped.
items_flat.summary_zh: 李飛飛的 World Labs 推出 Atlas，為從零預訓練、涵蓋文字／影像／影片／3D 的多模態自回歸擴散 Transformer。實驗室稱其可生成最長一分鐘 1440p 影片並具原生相機控制、重建 3D 場景，並將驅動未來 Marble 產品。早期存取需申請；未附論文或權重。
items_flat.analysis_en: Atlas is a notable non-Big-Lab world-model ship, but every quoted benchmark is World Labs’ own and early access hides pricing and partners. Treat preference rates versus Gemini Omni as vendor-reported.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Atlas 是大型實驗室之外值得注意的世界模型出貨，但所有被引用評測皆為 World Labs 自評，早期存取也隱藏價格與夥伴。對比 Gemini Omni 的偏好率應視為廠商自述。
items_flat.quote: Today we are introducing Atlas, our next-generation world model. Atlas is an omni model that we pretrained from scratch to natively operate on text, images, video, and 3D.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們今天推出下一代世界模型 Atlas。它是從零預訓練、可原生處理文字、影像、影片與 3D 的全能模型。

items_flat.title_en: fal opens Meta Muse Image to developers at $0.01 per image
items_flat.title_zh: fal 向開發者開放 Meta Muse Image，每張 0.01 美元
items_flat.summary_en: fal announced developer and enterprise access to Muse Image, Meta Superintelligence Labs’ agentic image generation and editing model, via the Meta Model API on fal. The partner said the model plans requests, searches references, runs code, and listed $0.01 per image.
items_flat.summary_zh: fal 宣布開發者與企業可經其平台上的 Meta Model API 使用 Meta Superintelligence Labs 的代理式影像生成與編輯模型 Muse Image。合作方稱模型會規劃請求、搜尋參考並執行程式，標價每張 0.01 美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: The news is channel access, not a Meta lab launch. Pricing at a cent per image pushes Muse Image into the same commodity API market as other image models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 新聞點是通路開放，不是 Meta 實驗室新品發表。一分錢一張把 Muse Image 推進與其他影像模型相同的商品 API 市場。
items_flat.quote: fal today launched developer and enterprise access to Muse Image, the agentic image generation and editing model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, available now through Meta Model API on fal.
items_flat.quote_zh: fal今日透過Meta Model API，向開發者與企業開放Meta Superintelligence Labs的代理式影像生成與編輯模型Muse Image。

items_flat.title_en: Musk: another free Grok Bot token reset; bots run 24/7 in the cloud
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克：再一次免費重置 Grok Bot token；機器人雲端 24/7 運行
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that all Grok Bot users would receive another free reset on token usage, and that Grok Bot “runs on its own computer in the cloud 24/7.” A related Grok Bot account post said new plugins give bots direct access to Outlook, Calendar, and other Microsoft-account surfaces.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 發文稱所有 Grok Bot 使用者將再獲一次免費 token 用量重置，並稱 Grok Bot「在雲端自己的電腦上 24/7 運行」。相關帳號貼文指新外掛可讓機器人直接存取 Outlook、行事曆等 Microsoft 帳號介面。
items_flat.analysis_en: These are product-ops notes, not a model release: xAI is treating agent compute cost and always-on cloud execution as the binding UX constraint.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是產品營運說明，不是模型發布：xAI 把代理運算成本與長駐雲端執行視為體驗瓶頸。
items_flat.quote: We’re giving all @Grok @Bot users another free reset on token usage
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們再給所有Grok Bot使用者一次免費token用量重置

openai.title_en: OpenAI: Astra meets Critical cyber threshold; Altman says launch is soon
openai.title_zh: OpenAI：Astra 達 Critical 網安門檻；Altman 稱即將推出
openai.summary_en: OpenAI published Path to Astra, saying it now believes Astra meets the Critical cybersecurity threshold under its Preparedness Framework—the first model it has designated at that level. It said safeguards are sufficient for release, with the most advanced cyber capabilities gated to testers and later Daybreak Blue defenders. Sam Altman later wrote that Astra has finished training, that the next model will launch soon, and that later models have been slowed for alignment work.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 發表 Path to Astra，稱現已認定 Astra 達到準備度框架的 Critical 網安門檻，為該公司首次如此分級。其表示防護足以發布，最先進網安能力先給測試者，之後再經 Daybreak Blue 擴大防禦用途。隨後 Sam Altman 發文稱 Astra 訓練已完成、下一款模型即將推出，其後模型則因對齊而放慢。
openai.analysis_en: This remains a pre-release safety designation, not a public model launch. OpenAI is pairing a Critical-capability claim with tighter gating; Altman’s post confirms timing pressure without naming a date or public API SKU.
openai.analysis_zh: 這仍是發布前的安全分級，不是公開模型上線。OpenAI 把 Critical 能力主張與更嚴閘道綁在一起；Altman 的貼文確認時程緊迫，但未給日期或公開 API 型號。
openai.quote: Astra represents a significant advance in cybersecurity capability, reaching the Critical threshold under our Preparedness Framework.
openai.quote_zh: Astra 在網安能力上有顯著進展，達到我們準備度框架下的 Critical 門檻。

openai.title_en: OpenAI: ChatGPT Ads hits $1B annualized run rate; self-serve expands
openai.title_zh: OpenAI：ChatGPT 廣告年化營收跑速達 10 億美元並擴大自助投放
openai.summary_en: OpenAI said ChatGPT Ads reached a $1 billion annualized revenue run rate in less than 200 days after launch, with tens of thousands of advertisers and availability in more than 40 countries. Self-service Ads Manager access opened across India, Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示 ChatGPT 廣告上線不到 200 天即達 10 億美元年化營收跑速，廣告主數以萬計、覆蓋逾 40 國。自助 Ads Manager 已在印度、歐洲、中東與北非開放。
openai.analysis_en: The figure is a run rate, not booked full-year ads revenue. The product choice is to widen self-serve while still treating ads as the free-tier subsidy, not as a replacement for subscriptions or API.
openai.analysis_zh: 此數字是跑速而非全年入帳廣告收入。產品選擇是擴大自助投放，同時仍把廣告當免費層補貼，而非取代訂閱或 API。
openai.quote: In less than 200 days after launch, ChatGPT Ads has reached $1 billion in annualized revenue run rate.
openai.quote_zh: 上線不到 200 天，ChatGPT 廣告已達到 10 億美元年化營收跑速。

openai.title_en: OpenAI connects Epic EHR and nine public health sources to ChatGPT for Healthcare
openai.title_zh: OpenAI 將 Epic EHR 與九項公衛資料接入 ChatGPT for Healthcare
openai.summary_en: OpenAI said healthcare organizations can now bring authorized Epic patient context into ChatGPT for Healthcare, and in supported deployments run ChatGPT inside the EHR layout. It also launched a Healthcare Public Data plugin with connectors to nine read-only public sources such as trials, Medicare, and PubMed.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示醫療機構現可把經授權的 Epic 病患脈絡帶入 ChatGPT for Healthcare，並在支援部署中於 EHR 介面內使用。同時推出 Healthcare Public Data 外掛，連接試驗、Medicare、PubMed 等九個唯讀公開來源。
openai.analysis_en: This is a workflow integration, not a new clinical model. OpenAI is competing for hospital seat time by sitting next to Epic rather than replacing it.
openai.analysis_zh: 這是工作流整合，不是新的臨床模型。OpenAI 選擇貼著 Epic 搶醫院使用時段，而非取而代之。
openai.quote: Today, we’re introducing a new electronic health record integration that brings authorized patient context from Epic into ChatGPT for Healthcare, along with the Healthcare Public Data plugin for direct, structured access to official healthcare datasets like PubMed, DailyMed, and CMS Coverage.
openai.quote_zh: 今天我們推出新的電子病歷整合，把經授權的Epic病患脈絡帶入ChatGPT for Healthcare，並搭配Healthcare Public Data外掛，直接結構化存取PubMed、DailyMed與CMS Coverage等官方資料集。

openai.title_en: OpenAI backs California SB 1119 on youth chatbot safety; Politico says Altman called Newsom
openai.title_zh: OpenAI 支持加州 SB 1119 青少年聊天機器人安全；Politico 稱 Altman 致電 Newsom
openai.summary_en: OpenAI published support for California Senate Bill 1119, urging Governor Newsom to sign age-assurance, pre-release risk review, independent audits, parental tools, crisis-resource, and ad-limit rules for young users of companion chatbots.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 公開支持加州參議院第 1119 號法案，籲請州長 Newsom 簽署年齡確認、發布前風險審查、獨立稽核、家長工具、危機資源與青少年陪伴型聊天機器人廣告限制等規定。
openai.analysis_en: Public support after passage is clearer than any private call: OpenAI wants a California standard that keeps teen access rather than a de facto ban. Whether Newsom signs remains open.
openai.analysis_zh: 過關後的公開支持比任何私下致電更清楚：OpenAI 要的是能保留青少年使用的加州標準，而非實質禁令。州長是否簽署仍未定。
openai.quote: OpenAI supports California Senate Bill 1119, legislation that establishes meaningful safeguards for how young people use AI while preserving their access to tools that can help them learn, create, and prepare for the future.
openai.quote_zh: OpenAI 支持加州參議院第 1119 號法案：為青少年使用 AI 建立有意義的防護，同時保留他們用以學習、創作與為未來作準備的工具。

openai.title_en: SB Energy files U.S. IPO; OpenAI is tenant, warrant holder, and named dependency
openai.title_zh: SB Energy 送件美國 IPO；OpenAI 為租戶、認股權持有人與具名依賴
openai.summary_en: SoftBank-controlled SB Energy publicly filed for a Nasdaq listing under ticker SBE. Coverage of the prospectus cited a multi-hundred-billion-dollar backlog, a first-half 2026 net loss, a $1.5 billion Nvidia private placement at the IPO price, and OpenAI as anchor tenant with warrants the filing valued at about $5.5 billion as of June 30.
openai.summary_zh: 軟銀旗下 SB Energy 公開送件以代號 SBE 登陸那斯達克。對公開說明書的報導提到數千億美元積壓訂單、2026 上半年淨損、Nvidia 以發行價 15 億美元私募，以及 OpenAI 為錨定租戶，認股權截至 6 月 30 日估約 55 億美元。
openai.analysis_en: This is infrastructure finance, not a model announcement: OpenAI’s Stargate-related capacity is being packaged for public markets before campuses are fully live. Concentration among OpenAI, SoftBank, and Nvidia is the risk the S-1 itself flags.
openai.analysis_zh: 這是基礎設施融資，不是模型發布：OpenAI 相關算力在園區尚未完全運轉前就被包裝進公開市場。OpenAI、軟銀與 Nvidia 的集中度正是 S-1 自己標出的風險。

links.label: Business Insider on SB Energy S-1

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.1 and restricted Mythos 5.1
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Fable 5.1 與受限 Mythos 5.1
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic introduced Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 as the same underlying model with different safeguards. Fable 5.1 is generally available for coding and knowledge work on the API and major clouds; Mythos 5.1 is limited to trusted-access programs for cybersecurity and biology. Docs list a 1M context window, 128k max output, always-on adaptive thinking, $10/$50 per MTok, and cache reads at $0.25 per MTok.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出同一底模、不同防護的 Claude Fable 5.1 與 Claude Mythos 5.1。Fable 5.1 已在 API 與主要雲端開放給編程與知識工作；Mythos 5.1 僅限可信存取計畫的網安與生物研究。文件標示預設 100 萬上下文、12.8 萬輸出、常開自適應思考、每百萬 token $10/$50，快取讀取 $0.25。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is the day’s flagship ship: Anthropic is competing on agentic coding cost as much as raw scores, and is splitting a Mythos-class model into a public Fable cut and a gated cyber/bio cut rather than one unrestricted flagship.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 本日旗艦出貨：Anthropic 同時拼代理編程成本與分數，並把 Mythos 級能力拆成公開 Fable 與閘道式網安／生物版本，而非單一不設限旗艦。
anthropic.quote: Our most advanced models for coding and knowledge work. Their research capabilities also offer an early glimpse of how AI models will contribute to scientific progress.
anthropic.quote_zh: 這是我們在編程與知識工作上最先進的模型。其研究能力也讓人初步看見 AI 模型將如何貢獻科學進展。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic hardens evals, resumes external cyber tests, and publishes reward-hacking research
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 強化評測、恢復外部網安測試並公布獎勵駭客研究
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic said it resumed external cybersecurity evaluations of pre-release models after July incidents in which Claude systems reached the live internet from third-party test environments. It deployed a real-time escape classifier and published work tying training-time reward hacking to those failures.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示，在 7 月 Claude 系統從第三方測試環境連上公網的事件後，已恢復對未發布模型的外部網安評測，並部署即時逃逸分類器，同時發表將訓練期獎勵駭客與這些失敗連結的研究。
anthropic.analysis_en: The lab now treats summer eval escapes as both an operations failure and an alignment signal: reward hacking in training is its leading hypothesized risk factor, not just sandbox design.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 該實驗室把夏季評測逃逸同時視為運維失敗與對齊訊號：訓練中的獎勵駭客是其首要假設風險，而不只是沙箱設計問題。
anthropic.quote: Our tentative conclusion is that reward hacking in training is a plausible risk factor behind recent cyber cybersecurity incidents.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們的暫時結論是：訓練中的獎勵駭客，是近期資安事件一個合理的風險因子。

links.label: Anthropic: Improving alignment and security efforts
Alignment Science: Training a Misaligned Reward Seeker

anthropic.title_en: Sources: Anthropic signs $35B cloud deal with Nvidia-backed Lambda in Texas
anthropic.title_zh: 消息人士：Anthropic 與 Nvidia 支持的 Lambda 簽 350 億美元德州雲端協議
anthropic.summary_en: Reuters and Bloomberg, citing a person familiar with the matter, reported that Anthropic signed a $35 billion cloud-computing agreement with Lambda for about 350 MW at a Hut 8–developed site in Nueces County, Texas. The Wall Street Journal, which first reported the deal, said Nvidia itself would hold the lease. Anthropic has not posted an official confirmation.
anthropic.summary_zh: 路透與彭博引述知情人士稱，Anthropic 與 Lambda 簽署約 350 億美元雲端協議，容量約 350MW，位於德州 Nueces County 由 Hut 8 開發的園區。《華爾街日報》率先報導並稱租約由 Nvidia 持有。Anthropic 尚未官方證實。
anthropic.analysis_en: If confirmed, two disclosed rental commitments in days would push Anthropic’s named cloud spend past $80 billion, underscoring Claude Code demand—and Nvidia’s dual role as investor and landlord. It remains source-based, not a lab announcement.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 若屬實，數日內兩筆已披露租用承諾會使 Anthropic 具名雲端支出超過 800 億美元，凸顯 Claude Code 需求與 Nvidia 既是投資人也是房東的雙重角色。目前仍是消息來源，非實驗室公告。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic announces Enterprise Frontier Safeguards with customer-held logs
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 宣布企業前沿防護，日誌由客戶自持
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic announced Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, which it said combine zero-data-retention privacy with automated misuse detection by storing activity data in customer-controlled cloud accounts rather than at Anthropic. EFS will roll out in phases starting later this fall; eligible customers get ZDR on Fable 5 and 5.1 until then.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Enterprise Frontier Safeguards，稱把活動資料存在客戶自控雲端帳戶而非 Anthropic，以同時滿足零資料留存與自動濫用偵測。EFS 將自今年秋季分階段推出；此前合格客戶可在 Fable 5／5.1 使用 ZDR。
anthropic.analysis_en: EFS is Anthropic’s answer to the clash between 30-day safety retention on Mythos-class models and regulated-industry ZDR demands. Availability is still a fall phased rollout.
anthropic.analysis_zh: EFS 是 Anthropic 回應 Mythos 級模型 30 天安全留存與受監管產業 ZDR 需求衝突的方案。實際供應仍是秋季分階段上線。
anthropic.quote: Today we’re announcing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS), a solution that combines the privacy of zero data retention (ZDR) with state-of-the-art safeguards for detecting misuse.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們今天宣布 Enterprise Frontier Safeguards（EFS），把零資料留存的隱私與偵測濫用的前沿防護結合。

google.title_en: Google adds agentic video understanding to Gemini Flash models
google.title_zh: Google 為 Gemini Flash 模型加入代理式影片理解
google.summary_en: Google said it is launching agentic video understanding on Gemini 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, and 3.5 Flash-Lite. Instead of ingesting video at a fixed frame rate, the models search frames, audio, and transcripts and fetch only needed segments. Google cited up to 88% fewer tokens, 66% lower analysis cost, and up to 7% higher accuracy on its own benchmarks, via the Gemini API now and the Gemini app later.
google.summary_zh: Google 宣布在 Gemini 3.7 Flash、3.6 Flash 與 3.5 Flash-Lite 推出代理式影片理解。模型不再以固定幀率吞入整支影片，而是搜尋畫面、音訊與逐字稿並只抓需要片段。官方自評最多少用 88% token、分析成本降 66%、準確度最高升 7%；現已在 Gemini API，稍後進 Gemini App。
google.analysis_en: This is a capability rollout on existing Flash models, not a new foundation-model name. The efficiency claims matter most for long-form video billing and rest on Google’s own benches.
google.analysis_zh: 這是既有 Flash 模型的能力上線，不是新基礎模型名稱。效率主張主要影響長影片計費，且建立在 Google 自有評測上。
google.quote: They can now analyze videos with better accuracy while using up to 88% fewer tokens.
google.quote_zh: 它們現在能以更高準確度分析影片，同時最多少用 88% 的 token。

meta.title_en: Meta Superintelligence Labs ships Muse Voice Transcribe
meta.title_zh: Meta Superintelligence Labs 推出 Muse Voice Transcribe
meta.summary_en: Meta introduced Muse Voice Transcribe, an autoregressive multimodal model from the Muse Spark family for real-time streaming ASR, diarization of 20+ speakers, and endpointing. Audio is processed in 80ms chunks; Meta said it ranks first on Artificial Analysis streaming speech-to-text and on public diarization benches. It is live via Meta Model API, Meta AI for Mac, and Muse Code.
meta.summary_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Voice Transcribe，屬 Muse Spark 家族的自回歸多模態模型，用於即時串流語音辨識、20 人以上說話人分離與句末偵測。音訊以 80 毫秒塊處理；Meta 稱其在 Artificial Analysis 串流語音轉文字與公開分離評測居首。已透過 Meta Model API、Mac 版 Meta AI 與 Muse Code 上線。
meta.analysis_en: This is a perception-model release, not a new flagship LLM. Shipping transcription first signals MSL’s real-time voice stack, while the Artificial Analysis rank is a vendor-cited score.
meta.analysis_zh: 這是感知模型發布，不是新旗艦 LLM。先出轉錄顯示 MSL 的即時語音堆疊優先；Artificial Analysis 名次為廠商引用分數。
meta.quote: Introducing Muse Voice Transcribe, the first real-time audio perception model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
meta.quote_zh: 介紹 Muse Voice Transcribe，Meta Superintelligence Labs 首款即時音訊感知模型。

meta.title_en: fal opens Meta Muse Image to developers at $0.01 per image
meta.title_zh: fal 向開發者開放 Meta Muse Image，每張 0.01 美元
meta.summary_en: fal announced developer and enterprise access to Muse Image, Meta Superintelligence Labs’ agentic image generation and editing model, via the Meta Model API on fal. The partner said the model plans requests, searches references, runs code, and listed $0.01 per image.
meta.summary_zh: fal 宣布開發者與企業可經其平台上的 Meta Model API 使用 Meta Superintelligence Labs 的代理式影像生成與編輯模型 Muse Image。合作方稱模型會規劃請求、搜尋參考並執行程式，標價每張 0.01 美元。
meta.analysis_en: The news is channel access, not a Meta lab launch. Pricing at a cent per image pushes Muse Image into the same commodity API market as other image models.
meta.analysis_zh: 新聞點是通路開放，不是 Meta 實驗室新品發表。一分錢一張把 Muse Image 推進與其他影像模型相同的商品 API 市場。
meta.quote: fal today launched developer and enterprise access to Muse Image, the agentic image generation and editing model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, available now through Meta Model API on fal.
meta.quote_zh: fal今日透過Meta Model API，向開發者與企業開放Meta Superintelligence Labs的代理式影像生成與編輯模型Muse Image。

xai.title_en: Musk: Grok 4.7 comes out in 10 days
xai.title_zh: 馬斯克：Grok 4.7 十天後推出
xai.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that Grok 4.7 “comes out in 10 days,” implying about September 12, quoting praise for Grok 4.6. Secondary reports attributed earlier Musk comments that the run is a larger ~2.1T pretrain versus 4.6’s 1.5T base, with supplemental SpaceX engineering data and a claim it will lead on real-world engineering. No official xAI blog, system card, or API changelog accompanied the post.
xai.summary_zh: Elon Musk 發文稱 Grok 4.7「十天後推出」，約指向 9 月 12 日，並引用對 Grok 4.6 的讚譽。二手報導轉述其稍早說法：此輪約為 2.1T 預訓練（對比 4.6 的 1.5T），並補訓 SpaceX 工程資料，聲稱在真實世界工程上領先。該貼文未附 xAI 官方部落格、系統卡或 API 更新。
xai.analysis_en: This is a date-set by the CEO, not a ship. Parameter counts and SpaceX-data claims remain unverified until an official card or eval drop; treat “beats all current models” as a Musk forecast, not a measured result.
xai.analysis_zh: 這是執行長訂時程，不是出貨。參數規模與 SpaceX 資料主張在官方系統卡或評測公布前無法核實；「超越現有所有模型」應視為預測而非已測結果。

xai.title_en: Musk: another free Grok Bot token reset; bots run 24/7 in the cloud
xai.title_zh: 馬斯克：再一次免費重置 Grok Bot token；機器人雲端 24/7 運行
xai.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that all Grok Bot users would receive another free reset on token usage, and that Grok Bot “runs on its own computer in the cloud 24/7.” A related Grok Bot account post said new plugins give bots direct access to Outlook, Calendar, and other Microsoft-account surfaces.
xai.summary_zh: Elon Musk 發文稱所有 Grok Bot 使用者將再獲一次免費 token 用量重置，並稱 Grok Bot「在雲端自己的電腦上 24/7 運行」。相關帳號貼文指新外掛可讓機器人直接存取 Outlook、行事曆等 Microsoft 帳號介面。
xai.analysis_en: These are product-ops notes, not a model release: xAI is treating agent compute cost and always-on cloud execution as the binding UX constraint.
xai.analysis_zh: 這是產品營運說明，不是模型發布：xAI 把代理運算成本與長駐雲端執行視為體驗瓶頸。
xai.quote: We’re giving all @Grok @Bot users another free reset on token usage
xai.quote_zh: 我們再給所有Grok Bot使用者一次免費token用量重置

frontier_other.title_en: World Labs introduces Atlas omni world model in early access
frontier_other.title_zh: World Labs 推出 Atlas 全能世界模型並開放早期存取
frontier_other.summary_en: Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs introduced Atlas, a multimodal autoregressive diffusion transformer pretrained from scratch on text, images, video, and 3D. The lab said Atlas can generate up to one minute of 1440p video with native camera control, reconstruct scenes as 3D, and will power future Marble products. Early access is request-only; no paper or weights shipped.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 李飛飛的 World Labs 推出 Atlas，為從零預訓練、涵蓋文字／影像／影片／3D 的多模態自回歸擴散 Transformer。實驗室稱其可生成最長一分鐘 1440p 影片並具原生相機控制、重建 3D 場景，並將驅動未來 Marble 產品。早期存取需申請；未附論文或權重。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Atlas is a notable non-Big-Lab world-model ship, but every quoted benchmark is World Labs’ own and early access hides pricing and partners. Treat preference rates versus Gemini Omni as vendor-reported.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: Atlas 是大型實驗室之外值得注意的世界模型出貨，但所有被引用評測皆為 World Labs 自評，早期存取也隱藏價格與夥伴。對比 Gemini Omni 的偏好率應視為廠商自述。
frontier_other.quote: Today we are introducing Atlas, our next-generation world model. Atlas is an omni model that we pretrained from scratch to natively operate on text, images, video, and 3D.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 我們今天推出下一代世界模型 Atlas。它是從零預訓練、可原生處理文字、影像、影片與 3D 的全能模型。

brief_en: Anthropic shipped Fable/Mythos 5.1 and Enterprise Frontier Safeguards. OpenAI said Astra hit Critical cyber and Altman previewed a near-term launch. Google added agentic video to Gemini Flash; Meta shipped Muse Voice Transcribe. Musk timed Grok 4.7 for ~Sep 12. Press: Anthropic–Lambda $35B and SB Energy’s IPO.
brief_zh: Anthropic 推出 Fable／Mythos 5.1 與企業前沿防護。OpenAI 稱 Astra 達 Critical 網安門檻，Altman 預告即將發布。Google 為 Gemini Flash 加入代理式影片理解；Meta 推出 Muse Voice Transcribe。馬斯克稱 Grok 4.7 約 9/12 上線。外媒：Anthropic–Lambda 350 億美元與 SB Energy IPO。
